subject: ACME POC kickoff recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme.com>, Patricia Gomez <patricia.gomez@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME POC kickoff recap and next steps

Hi Jordan / Patricia 

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap from our kickoff and agreed next steps so we have everything in one place. Please review and confirm or flag anything we missed.

POC scope (what we agreed)
- Integrate Redwood hosted inference for Acme Support Assist (customer-facing chat) for a 4-week pilot.
- Focus flows: triage classification, canned response generation, and follow-up summarization.
- Environment: Redwood hosted (dedicated pool) using the rdl-1 family model variants.

Success metrics (what we'll measure)
- Latency: p50 < 300ms, p95 < 900ms for 256-token requests.
- Quality: baseline F1 on intent classification >= 0.90; response relevance score target >= 0.85 (evaluated on prompt set).
- Cost: target inference cost < $1,200/week for expected volume (~500k tokens/week).

Prompt set / evals
- Acme will provide a 200-example labeled prompt set covering top 12 intents (+ edge cases).
- Redwood will run an initial eval (quality + regressions) and produce a short report and sample outputs.

Owners and roles
- Acme: Jordan Lee (project lead) and Patricia Gomez (ops / data access).
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE, project owner), Aditya Rao (Sales Engineer  procurement & infra), Rishi Malhotra (Solutions Engineer  integration & evals).

Timeline / milestones
- Week 0 (this week): access and data handoff, finalize scope doc (attachment).
- Week 1: baseline eval and model + prompt tuning; weekly sync on Fri.
- Week 2-3: iterative tuning, performance monitoring, end-to-end test.
- Week 4: final evaluation and handoff / next steps.

Access / setup items (action items for Acme)
1) Provide an S3 test bucket (or sample dataset) with the labeled prompts and a small production-like sample (CSV/json).
2) Add redwood-poc@acme-ops IAM role or share a short-lived pre-signed URL for the sample data.
3) Provide a billing/POC billing contact and PO number if you want to start dedicated capacity now (Aditya to follow up).

Attachments included: redwood-poc-scope.pdf (scope + success criteria), access-checklist.csv (fields we need).

Immediate next steps
- Jordan: share access to the sample prompt set by EOD Tue (2027-04-19).
- Aditya: will send the procurement checklist and DocuSign link for the PO.
- Rishi: will schedule the technical kickoff session and share the Zoom invite.

If that all looks right, Jordan  a one-line confirm is perfect and we'll get started.

Thanks!


Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-poc-scope.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)
Attachment: access-checklist.csv (CSV, 1 KB)

Marissa 

Thanks for the thorough recap. Confirmed on our side. We'll aim to deliver the 200-example labeled prompt set and a ~1k-row sample dataset by EOD Tuesday (2027-04-19). Samir (cc'd) will provision the S3 bucket and add the redwood-poc@acme-ops role with read access.

- On cost: we prefer to keep the pilot in hosted dedicated capacity for predictable performance; Aditya, please advise if we need to sign a short-term PO to lock capacity.

I'll confirm once Samir has created the bucket and shared the ARNs.
